benchmark.name: The Riv Burger
benchmark.reason: Steve's nominated junior-course benchmark and the current strongest complete junior family reference. It is used for interaction and learning discipline only; Desk Tidy sources remain the sole authority for Desk Tidy facts.
benchmark.head: 2d6aaaed233a931dc1edfb005d84c70c02399dbe

preservedStrengths: Five coherent two-week modules and 15 substantial project-specific theory sections
Five editable eight-slide presentations placed before theory as downloads
150 section-grouped knowledge checks and 20 scaffolded higher-order responses
24 distinct placed teaching visuals with accurate alt text, captions, Notice prompts and Open larger routes
14 matched section videos plus one honest clear-finish no-clip exception with an equivalent on-page pathway
15 section-matched Applied Learning Activities using five mechanics, saved feedback and printable low-tech alternatives
Twelve-card stage-based photo folio with autosave, progress, JSON/ZIP backup and PDF print
Current v2.0 25-period teacher program and source-safe assessment boundary

gaps.evidence: The accepted build has a canonical external source record, while this later candidate needs an in-repository Stage 20 revalidation record bound to the current baseline and network-gap contract.
gaps.acceptanceTest: Versioned source/build/core manifests bind the current baseline to the canonical source-map digest, preserve defined SRC-PROGRAM-V1.3 activity traceability, classify v2.0 as a derived teacher-review output, and retain the exact handbook digest and 2027 Teacher-to-confirm boundary.
gaps.sourceLimitation: The 2026 handbook is the latest verified planning reference, not authority for a 2027 formal task or notice.

gaps.evidence: The theory, visual, video, activity link and ten checks are section-linked, but all four written capstones are rendered together at the bottom of each module.
gaps.acceptanceTest: Module 1, then all 15 sections, visibly follow theory -> visual -> matched video or recorded exception -> embedded activity -> ten checks -> mapped capstone. Existing prompts, indices, storage keys and saved work remain compatible; four capstones per module remain intact.
gaps.sourceLimitation: Closely related capstones may remain combined only where the existing prompt authentically covers more than one related idea.

gaps.evidence: Every theory section has an excellent activity panel, but it opens a separate route rather than allowing the interaction within the section learning flow.
gaps.acceptanceTest: Each section can expand and complete the existing activity in place, using the same saved record, feedback, keyboard/touch alternative and low-tech route as the activity bank. Full-page fallback remains available and no duplicate activity implementation is introduced.
gaps.sourceLimitation: Do not replace the existing source-matched mechanics with a generic quiz or force a new activity count.

gaps.evidence: Module, activity-bank and folio progress exist separately, but the landing page has no whole-course summary or resume-next-useful-action route.
gaps.acceptanceTest: A fresh browser shows Start Module 1. Seeded module, activity and folio records produce accurate separate counts and calm resume links for learning, formative practice and folio evidence. Reload and cross-tab storage updates remain accurate; formal submission is never implied.
gaps.sourceLimitation: Completion must reflect meaningful saved actions and must not infer teacher observation or formal assessment completion.

gaps.evidence: The folio ZIP/JSON backup covers only desk_tidy_folio_v1. Five module records and 15 activity records remain device-local and outside a transferable whole-course backup.
gaps.acceptanceTest: Save a module check, capstone, activity record, folio response and folio photo; export one course backup; clear those test records; restore; verify every record, image and progress value returns. Wrong-course, malformed and unsupported files fail safely. Restore warns before overwriting existing work.
gaps.sourceLimitation: Backup remains student-controlled browser data, not cloud submission or school storage.

gaps.evidence: The 90 appended checks are unique and have section-specific explanations, but each distractor was wrapped in the same generic wrong-answer sentence.
gaps.acceptanceTest: Every added question retains four options and one correct answer, while each incorrect option receives non-empty misconception-specific feedback that explains why it does not fit and supports a return to the exact theory section.
gaps.sourceLimitation: Feedback must explain existing theory and must not add new technical, safety or practical facts.

gaps.evidence: All five eight-slide decks are downloadable before theory, but the module pages provide no visual preview of the slides.
gaps.acceptanceTest: Every deck is rendered and inspected slide by slide with no unresolved clipping/overflow; each module displays a useful accessible preview linked to a larger image and retains the PPTX download.
gaps.sourceLimitation: This pass does not redesign accepted decks or introduce unsupported slide claims.

gaps.evidence: Module titles and purposes are clear, but prior learning and the immediate next action are not explicitly labelled at module entry.
gaps.acceptanceTest: Each module entry identifies its source-safe prior learning and the next concrete learning action without inventing practical authority or adding a new teaching sequence.

gaps.evidence: The final-module All modules link targets #modules, which does not exist on the Desk Tidy landing page.
gaps.acceptanceTest: The link resolves to index.html#course-map-title and moves focus/navigation to the real course map without a missing-fragment target.

criteria: All three section packages use the complete local learning flow
Four existing capstones remain saved under compatible indices and appear beside their mapped section
Three existing activities expand in place and retain full-page/print fallbacks
Presentation preview and download are usable
Progress, resume and full-course backup survive reload and restore
Laptop and exact innerWidth 390 rendering have no page overflow, broken assets or console errors
module1Pilot.scaleRule: Apply the accepted implementation pattern to all 15 sections and five modules without copying facts or replacing the clear-finish video exception.
